name: The sandbox is opened to outbound network traffic
description: network_access in the sandbox_workspace_write table decides whether a command the agent runs may reach the network at all. Granting it pairs a writable workspace with egress, which is what turns a file the agent read into a file an attacker receives.
message: The sandbox is opened to outbound network traffic

name: The local and private-network guard is disabled
description: allow_local_binding disables the guard that keeps agent-run traffic off loopback and private-range addresses. A cloud instance-metadata endpoint and an internal service both answer at addresses the guard otherwise refuses, and neither sits on the public internet a host pattern is written for.
message: With sandboxed networking enabled, allow_local_binding drops the guard that keeps agent traffic off loopback and private-range addresses

name: Every Unix socket on the machine is admitted
description: dangerously_allow_all_unix_sockets bypasses the Unix socket allowlist, which is a broad local escape hatch. A container-runtime control socket or an ssh-agent socket hands the agent host-level control or credential forwarding through a path that reads as a local file.
message: With sandboxed networking enabled, dangerously_allow_all_unix_sockets admits every Unix socket on the machine

name: The proxy listener may bind a non-loopback address
description: dangerously_allow_non_loopback_proxy allows proxy listeners to bind non-loopback addresses, which puts the agent's egress path on the network the machine sits on. Another host on that network then reaches a listener meant for this one.
message: With sandboxed networking enabled, dangerously_allow_non_loopback_proxy lets the proxy listener bind a non-loopback address
